detail.longDescription:
Attached: 2 images

PH4NTXM now has 2 editions you can select on build.

Using:
sudo ./build.sh --edition abyss
sudo ./build.sh --edition ghost

Made is simple for you, then, when the build finish, in the output folder you'll get a timestamped image.

Which one do you like more?
Abyss = Dark theme
Ghost = Bright theme

I love the Abyss bit more for longer sessions, cause it helps on reducing the eye-fatigue, but Ghost is looking clean and very high-tech as well.
